_comment: Corporate retickers: a universe ticker SEC's live map no longer lists, whose registrant SEC now lists under another ticker. Each CIK is cited from SEC's own ticker file (data/sec/company-tickers.json, which lists the CIK under the new ticker only). Read by seedManifest (lib/server/secManifest.ts) ONLY when the live map has no entry for the old ticker, so the manifest entry keeps its CIK and reconcile records retickeredTo. Not a rename of the page: the old ticker's page reads the same registrant's filings.

BK.name: Bank of New York Mellon Corp
BK.evidence: data/sec/company-tickers.json: [1390777, "Bank of New York Mellon Corp", "BNY", "NYSE"] and [1390777, ..., "BNY-PK", "NYSE"]; no row for BK. Reticker first observed 2026-09-13 (secManifest retickeredTo note).
